text:
rene: quick thought from today's infra sync — we should prototype a 'shadow-run' apply mode for runtime config that focuses on safety and cost transparency. idea: small percentage, simulatable routing, and a console playbook to stop/inspect/commit. want feedback on API and console affordances.

TIA: curious about 'simulatable routing' — you mean replay vs live hit?

rene: both options. two modes: 'replay' (no downstream billing, lightweight execution path) and 'live-isolated' (actual requests but routed to an isolated pool with separate quota). default to replay for Hosted customers.

sam: backend implications: we need a new apply state and a short-lived lease so only one active shadow-run per config per org. also need to emit a snapshot event at start and periodic deltas.

sre-bot: perf-check: ensure shadow runs don't affect autoscaler signals. If GPU pools see replay traffic we must filter it out of scaling heuristics.

ops-bot: note: every shadow-run must produce a correlation header X-Shadow-Run: sh-<cfg>-<nonce> so logs and traces can be joined. Also log operator id for audit.

mira: console UX suggestion: when a shadow-run is active show a compact 'experiment card' inline with the config change: state, cohort %, mode (replay|isolated), live sparkline (error/p95), estimated cost delta, and three actions: Pause, Abort+Revert, Promote. Pause stops cohort growth. Promote converts the run into a full rollout if criteria pass.

leo-pm: acceptance criteria: 1) teams can start shadow-run from Console or API; 2) default is replay and doesn't charge quotas; 3) console shows cost estimate when charge_shadow=true; 4) auto-abort policy exists but is opt-out per-change.

rene: auto-abort policy sketch: default thresholds = errors > 2x baseline OR p95 > 1.25x baseline for a 3m sustained window. revert should annotate with snapshot_id and reason. we should throttle auto-reverts to 1/min per org.

tia: how do we capture baseline? rolling 1h median before start? need to be explicit to avoid noisy baselines on low-traffic routes.

sam: implementation: compute baseline over 30m rolling with min-sample requirement (e.g., >= 100 requests). if below sample threshold, fallback to synthetic or require manual guardrail. add 'min_sample' field in policy.

ops-bot: compliance note: Dedicated customers may require explicit opt-in for replay mode if it touches customer data paths. For replay we must ensure PII is scrubbed or replay is done in a synthetic mode.

mira: UI flow: start modal collects: cohort_pct, ttl_secs, mode, charge_shadow (bool), auto_abort_policy (advanced). show a confirmation with estimated CPU/GPU cost and expected duration. also expose telemetry link to the snapshot timeline.

rene: API sketch: POST /runtime/configs.apply 
```
{
  "config_id": "route_quota_v3",
  "mode": "shadow",               // shadow | roll | instant
  "shadow_options": {
    "routing_mode": "replay",    // replay | live-isolated
    "cohort_pct": 0.25,
    "ttl_secs": 900,
    "charge_shadow": false
  },
  "auto_abort": {
    "enabled": true,
    "error_mult": 2.0,
    "p95_mult": 1.25,
    "window_secs": 180,
    "min_sample": 100
  }
}
```

leo-pm: API looks fine; two asks: expose a dry-run endpoint to preview the diff impact on effective routing (no telemetry) and return an estimated cost delta. second: limit concurrent runs per org to 3.

sam: backend note: prefer a flattened API to avoid nested objects in the proto; we can name fields shadow_routing_mode, shadow_cohort_pct, etc. also will add a lint that apply_mode/mode values are validated.

sre-bot: ops impact: for live-isolated we need an isolated pool tag and quota bucket; that requires infra work for Dedicated tenants. propose we alpha with replay-only for first ship.

rene: rollout plan: 1) alpha: API + backend state machine + telemetry + basic console card (replay only) 2) beta: isolated pool + quota handling for Dedicated 3) GA: promote action + org-level guardrails and billing options.

mira: expose a button on the card to 'snapshot metrics' which creates a stable reference point for postmortem. also allow exporting the snapshot for evals.

ops-bot: suggestion: include a short TTL for snapshot retention (default 7d) and a toggle to keep snapshot longer for audits.

rene: I'll draft an RFC with acceptance criteria and mocks. assigning owners: sam (api/runtime), tia (telemetry + baseline computation), mira (console), leo-pm (product).

leo-pm: timeline ask: alpha in 3 sprints with a small pilot org.

sam: ok, I'll add prototype stubs and a schema proposal.

mira: will add card task to frontend board and include UX for cost estimate and promote flow.

rene: thanks everyone. if no objections I'll file RFC by EOD and kick off the proto branch.

tia: no objections, excited to try.

leo-pm: go ahead.

mira: :rocket:
